outcomes.title: Flute Concertos

outcomes.reason: No Spotify album of the Debost/Moscow Chamber Orchestra/Barshai recording was verified. Debost Mozart material found on Spotify credits Orchestre de Paris/Daniel Barenboim, which is a different recording. Rampal/Ristenpart and Debost/Fournet flute-and-harp concerto results also have different performers or repertoire.

outcomes.title: Symphony No. 3
outcomes.editionNotes: 1994 Decca coupling: the first six tracks contain the original 1978 Los Angeles/Mehta Symphony No. 3 recording. Symphony No. 1 follows.

outcomes.title: Plays Bach at the Organ of Chartres Cathedral
outcomes.reason: No Charles Benbow/Chartres Cathedral Spotify album or corresponding organ artist page was verified. The four LP works are BWV565, BWV564, BWV542 and BWV548; substitute Bach organ recordings by another organist or on another instrument are not accepted.

outcomes.title: The 76/77 Show Album
outcomes.editionNotes: Digital package uses the original 1975–76 title. The photographed 1976–77 jacket is a renamed reissue of the same catalogue 1120 album; all twelve songs retain their original order. The digital theme song runs longer than the original label timing (3:51 versus 3:23).

outcomes.title: Handel's Messiah
outcomes.artist: Hermann Scherchen / Vienna State Opera Orchestra
outcomes.editionNotes: 2001 Westminster/DG reissue of Scherchen’s 1959 Vienna Messiah recording, with the original soloists and chorus.

outcomes.title: Plays Bach & Villa-Lobos
outcomes.reason: The exact Sine Qua Non SQN7765 Bach/Villa-Lobos compilation was not verified on Spotify. The LP rear identifies Bream’s 1956 Vienna sessions. Spotify carries the early Bach recital separately, but it lacks the five Villa-Lobos preludes; modern RCA and broad Bream anthologies are different packages and may contain later performances.

outcomes.title: The Polka Dot Pony
outcomes.reason: Poco is a documented retitle of The Polka Dot Pony, but current Spotify editions have substantially longer versions of three songs: Cat Came Back (3:34 versus 2:52), Piggyback Ride (1:13 versus 0:59) and Julie Gerond (8:18 versus 7:40). Their relationship to the original performances remains unconfirmed. No closer complete edition was verified.

outcomes.title: The Story and Songs from Walt Disney's Mary Poppins
outcomes.reason: No full ST3922 Dal McKennon/Marni Nixon Disneyland Storyteller album was verified. The official 2004 Storyteller single uses Karen Dotrice narration and a different programme. The Julie Andrews/Dick Van Dyke soundtrack and Legacy releases also do not match the LP cast.

outcomes.title: Merry Christmas
outcomes.editionNotes: The original twelve-song Merry Christmas programme is digitally titled White Christmas. Spotify’s displayed date differs from the photographed pressing.

outcomes.title: Bach on the Harpsichord and Clavichord

outcomes.title: Concertos for 2, 3 and 4 Harpsichords
outcomes.artist: I Solisti di Zagreb / Antonio Janigro
outcomes.reason: The candidate Bach harpsichord-concerto album omits BWV1065’s third movement and substitutes Fauré’s Violin Sonata No. 1, first movement, with Akira Eguchi. It is not the complete HM52/53SD programme. No complete alternative with the original Janigro/Heiller/Pischner/Rapf performances was verified.
